title: Personal taste assessment method and system
source: Australian Patent Office / World Intellectual Property Organization (PCT)
summary: This patent describes a personal taste assessment system that develops preference models for consumers based on their ratings of items such as wines and beverages. The system analyzes trait values associated with rated items to identify patterns of dependency and generate personalized recommendations and predictions for individual users or groups. Unlike existing recommendation systems that rely on direct product similarity, this system aims to identify underlying preference drivers to recommend apparently unrelated items the consumer may enjoy.
